batting.name: BJ Hodge
batting.dismissal: c R Ashwin b JA Morkel

batting.name: SC Ganguly
batting.dismissal: c JA Morkel b JM Kemp

batting.name: OA Shah
batting.dismissal: c MS Dhoni b L Balaji

batting.name: LR Shukla
batting.dismissal: c JA Morkel b M Muralitharan

batting.name: RS Gavaskar
batting.dismissal: c M Vijay b JM Kemp

balls.text: and what running by Dhoni, he is half way down the pitch by the time the ball reaches Badri, it's a yorker that he has barely dug out but Dhoni hares through for two
yorker, gets a leg-bye, after much deliberation, deciding Badri is fut enough to take strike

funny cricket, but not so funny in the end, Dhoni pulls hard to midwicket, comes back for the second, and both the batsmen are watching the ball and collide smack into each other. Obviously Badri is hurt, you don't want to be tackled by Dhoni running full speed! May as well get speared by a bull. Ishant, though - the legend that he is with running batsmen out - fails to collect the throw right over the top of the stumps, and gives away the extra run
slower delivery, but it's short, and he has pulled it down the ground, into the cow corner for four, the ball kept getting faster and faster as it reached the boundary, or so it seems
yorker on the pads, gets an inside edge for a single to fine leg
Badri you beauty! pick-up shot of the pads, just short of a length, into the pads and he has nearly cleaned up a police at the square-leg boundary
full, just short of being a yorker, and wide enough of Shah at extra cover, what an over - 17 off Bond, who is not the greatest of bowlers at the death

superb shot, flat flat pull, and one of the flattest sixes you will see, barely left the ground and still carried past the boundary, and nearly took out Kolkata's mascot, that giant tiger. He doesn't like these tigers! He is only saving the real tiger
the helicopter shot again, doesn;t connect well, gets a thick edge past Saha and gets the four that takes him to his fifty, off just 28 balls
yorker outside off, and he digs it out with an open face, and comes back for two despite having hit it straight to the deep fielder, superb running
fast length ball, again beats him for the pace, the fastness of it this time, gets a leg-bye
slower bouncer and Badri is flummoxed, plays the pull ages before the ball arrives
full on the pads, Badri slogs, gets inside edge, will take a single
slower ball, yorker length, digs it out powerfully, gets a singled to long-on
bye bye ball, Dhoni is getting into the act! length ball, clears front leg and goes over wide long-on, he is giving his bowlers something to bowl at
straight from the Dhoni school of batting, swats a length delivery from outside off, and beats long-on with the sheer power
beats him with a slower ball outside off, Saha does to collect it behind the swirling Dhoni bat
full toss on the pads, and it has been dealt accordingly, flat and powerfully past short fine
low full toss outside off, gets a single to extra cover
poor delivery, full toss on the pads, and Dhoni receives it with gratitude, flicked away past short fine leg
goes for the Dhoni helicopter-shot, gets a thick edge over point, will come back for two
short, into the body, pulled away to deep square leg for one
makes room again, this time Ishant goes outside off, and creates enough distance, and Badri misses
Badri makes room, Ishant follows him, and Badri nicely glances it fine, and the fine leg is too square
short delivery, played with soft hands towards long-on, and they run hard to make it a two. So Karthik finishes up without conceding a boundary
dances down the track, turns it into a low full toss, still can't get under it, gets a single
short delivery, hit straight to extra cover, gets a single
jumps out of the track again, gets too close to the ball, and can't get the elevation
gives him the charge, hits it wide of long-on, gets a couple
flat delivery, doesn't give him any room, hit back to the bowler
shot! first six of the innings! length ball, and absolutely smashes it over wide long-on, typical Dhoni shot
goes for the pull, straight to Ganguly at midwicket, Badri is ending up short but the throw is too full and Mathews doesn't collect it
full delivery, driven past extra cover, Shukla does a good job to run around from long-on to keep them down to two
another slower bouncer, pulled down the ground, gets just a single
makes room, Mathews bowls a slower bouncer, gets under it and plays it to third man for a single
Badri improvises, walks across the stumps, gets under the slower delivery, and gets enough power in it to clear the short fine leg
full delivery, driven wide of long-off, gets two
makes room, goes inside-out, gets one to sweeper-cover
comes forward and pushes this one down to long-off
short, slightly wide, and he misses, no contact here
another dot, can't punch it past point
flat delivery, can't get it past extra cover
slower ball, 139ks, worked away into the leg side for a single
runs this down to third man for a single
149ks, too quick for Badri, hurries him up and tucks him up, Badri almost treads onto his stumps
into the pads, 148ks, Badri uses the pace and gets four behind square
looks to turn this to leg, Bond gets him in the forearm with the extra bounce, gets a single to third man
plays down the ground with soft hands, slightly wide of long-on, comes back for two
jumps out of the crease, Karthik bowls flat, and he plays it straight to cover-point
tip-and-run this time, Karthik in the hurry fumbles, and gives away two
looks to pull a pretty full delivery, the mis-hit lands just short of Karthik
cut hard into the ground, straight to cover-point
shimmies down the pitch, flicks it with soft hands, but doesn't have the time to come back for two
drives a full delivery down to long-off
full delivery, driven down to long-off
slower ball, gets a thick outside edge
drives a length ball down to mid-off for a single
steers this one to third man for a single
looks to run it down to third man, there is extra bounce that beats him, and Saha takes this one well
Shukla on target, flicked straight to midwicket
fired down the leg side, not called a wide, could have brushed his pad
worked away off the middle stump, gets a single
flighted delivery, hit powerfully down the ground for a single
shorter delivery and nicely helped away past short third man, comes back for two
was there some drift? goes for the big drive through the off side but the ball is wide of his reach
and bowled him first ball! plays all around a nice flighted delivery on the leg stump! Was looking for the trademark hit over midwicket, and played down the wrong line
goes for the midwicket hit again, slices it down the ground, gets a single
full toss on the pads, flicked away for a single
bowled him! Shukla has his own back, bowls full, just short of being a yorker, Vijay looks to go through the off side, gets an inside edge, and the off stump goes for a walk
looks for the scoop over fine leg, but this is a slower delivery, and he guides it past short fine
hit past Shukla, in the air but he can't get his hand to it, will get just a single
goes for the extra-cover hit, gets the inside half of the bat, back to the bowler
flat delivery into the pads, misses but gets a leg-bye
pushed through the covers for a single
stops on him as he looks to drive, defends back to Karthik in the end
wide down the leg side, Saha removes the bails but Vijay is safe, he overbalanced and fell over after the bails were removed
arm ball, looks to run it down to third man, gets an inside edge
another couple, played with soft hands on the on side, and he gets two before the long-on can come around
well places, full toss, and he turns it with the wrists to between long-on and midwicket, gets two
driven away uppishly, but safely over the infield, gets a single to sweeper-cover
shapes up for the hit over midwicket, sees a slower ball and opens the face for a single to third man
smart shot, makes room, and cuts it hard, from in front of leg stump, well placed too
pushes a length delivery to extra cover for one
tip-and-run, to cover, he is in despite Hodge's direct-hit
nicely played and nicely fielded, Raina makes room and guides a slower bouncer past the keeper, but Sharma does well at the third-man boundary to save two runs by making a diving save
swiped across the line, between mid-on and midwicket, not the prettiest of strokes, but gets his four
cuts in front of square and in the air, and gets it one bounce to sweeper-cover
short and wide, doesn't connect on the cut shot, no feet there
shorter, outside off, swipes and misses, was looking for the midwicket stand here
on the pads, length ball, flicked away nicely
has a swipe at a length delivery, doesn't quite get it right, hits it limply to mid-on
Raina makes room for the big hit over extra, but it is a slower ball and he gets an inside edge towards short fine, will get a single
slower bouncer, 123.5ks, Raina pulls all over it
pushes it down the ground, mid-off is at the edge of the circle, gets a single
on target, around off, straightening just a touch, Vijay defends it back
tip-and-run again, towards cover, and makes it easily
length ball first up, pushes it to cover and takes a single
thick edge outside off, and he gets a single to third man
short and wide, and he slashes and misses, no foot movement
steered away square of backward point for a single
run-out opportunity, Raina pushes this shortish delivery square and turns down the single, Vijay was a goner had Murali Karthik hit direct
and he beats him outside off, tentative poke at a shortish delivery, good carry there
played on! no time for Mongoose again! looks to cut at the short delivery but it's too close to him, perhaps straightened a touch, and the underside edge hits the stumps, and Ishant is ecstatic
first full delivery from Bond, Hayden drives straight, so straight it knocks down stumps at the non-striker's end, takes a single off the ricochet
more circumspect this time, shoulders arms to one outside off
superb bowling, 147ks, pitches middle and leg and moves away and beats another swing from the Hayden bat
beaten by the movement, looks to hit at one outside off, but the ball moves away and beats him, 144ks, back of a length
tucks him up, bit he pushes it to cover-point and comes through for one
nice shot, plays away from the body but cuts it sweetly between the two points
gets a bottom edge on the cut shot, but they come through for one
slower ball, 128ks, gets an inside edge on the drive that falls short of Saha
lucky boundary here, looks to cut this one and gets an inside edge past the keeper, maybe not short enough to cut
drives at a short-of-a-length delivery outside off, and is beaten as the ball holds its line and bounces too
better this time, shorter, and outside off, Vijay plays it back to Sharma
a loosener on the pads, and nicely clipped away, over square leg, a pick-up shot really, bowled at 131ks, quite a relief from Bond's 145-ish
walks down the track, gets a bottom edge that falls safe
nips in again, which means away from the left-hand batsman, and Hayden lets it go
144.2ks, around off, moving away, Hayden shoulders arms
gets an inside edge on this one, gets off the mark with the single to fine leg
cuts him in two with the inward seam movement, close to 142ks, and bounces twice on the way to Saha
142.2ks, nips in from back of a length, defended off the front foot
and how it finishes! Karthik is strolling through for a single to point, and Badri hits the only visible stump direct. Karthik knew he wouldn't have made it
Sharma swings and misses outside off
Ishant comes down, gets a single to long-off
jumps out of the crease, Raina bowls short, Karthik hits down the ground for one
delays the delivery release, flicked away for one
and again, straight to Raina who fields well
hit back to Raina powerfully
big big shout for lbw, given runs, Raina thinks pad first, Saheba thinks bat first, it was headed for the stumps. Replay says pad first
doosra, pitches outside leg and turns away like a legbreak, Ishant is hit in the pad
dropped, hit right back at Murali, gets to him too soon
short ball, pulled away, gets a single
comes down the track, gets a single to long-off
driven with an open face, gets a single
defended back to the bowler
plays another delivery back to Ashwin
flat delivery, pushed back to the bowler
flicked off the pads, the crowd cheers, the horn goes off
short, cut cut straight to point
pushed down the ground again. Guys, you are Nos 10 and 11, play like them
pushed down the ground for a single
single to fine leg
worked off the pads for a single
swept away in front of square
looks to run nit behind square, and is beaten again
beats him outside off with a sharp offbreak
thick edge past short third man, gets four more
the straighter one, Ishant defends it back
chips it down the ground for one
this is cut away nicely past point, gets four
offbreak, beats Karthik on the front foot
pushes it down the ground for one
Bond takes a big swipe down the ground, misses by a long away, and the off stump is struck
and is beaten on the cut again - Murali cutting Murali
goes for the cut, and is beaten
sweeps this one in front of square
spins across him, defended
sweeps right down the throat of Albie Morkel at deep backward square leg, and Chennai two good balls away from a win here
goes for the big reverse-sweep, and is beaten
swiped across the lien, towards cow corner, but Hayden runs from midwicket and makes a fine save
played with an open face, gets a single past cover
moving in to Shukla, gets a leg-bye
and one more gone! Gavaskar pulls, not that shot perhaps, and the top edge is a pretty healthy one that makes it to the fine leg boundary, where Vijay takes it safely
slogs and misses, it's creeping up on Kolkata now
driven powerfully, but straight to sweeper-cover
opens the face, but hits straight to point
steps out of the crease again, Ashwin bowls short, Shukla opens the face and takes a single
comes down the track and hits a low full toss smack down the ground, straight, damn straight, and gets four
chipped away down the ground for one
pushes at one pitched outside leg, spinning towards middle, is beaten
tip-and-run, takes a single to cover
length ball driven down to long-off
into the pads, bunted away for a single
comes forward, pushes at one, half-shout suggesting pad first, but anyway the angle is taking it past off stump
play and miss right away, Sunny wouldn't have liked it
it's all over for Kolkata - barring a miracle. Mathews looks for the scoop, misses, and is this time hit inside the line. Dead duck if ever there was one
looks to work it on to leg, is struck in the thigh, gets two leg-byes
goes for the big sweep shot, misses but is hit outside the line
flat delivery and nicely he uses it pace, past backward point, gets four

bunted to single at midwicket, Dhoni to Raina: "C'mon Raina, aage rehne hota hai to peeche bhag jata hai; peeche rehna hota hai to aage aa jata hai." [C'mon Raina, when you need to come up to save a single, you sit back. When you need to be at the edge of the circle, you start running in."
runs this one down to third man, and Dhoni makes a left-handed collection again
carrom ball straight away, holds its line, beaten outside off
Mathews goes for the scoop over the keeper, misses, but is hit outside the line of off
worked off the pads for a single
and Dhoni has dropped it, regulation edge, wide of Dhoni and he dives and can't make, possible the injured arm coming into play
thick outside edge, Balaji makes a superb diving save at third man, and Dhoni makes a one-handed collection. Remember he was hit by Bond in the forearm
hits a length ball past cover for one

Eden is quiet! length ball, Ganguly looks to go over mid-on, who is up in the circle, but the ball doesn't quite come on, and he ends up dragging it to deep midwicket, where Morkel takes a smart catch
still going for Ganguly's hips-ribs, misdirected and gives away a wide
Ganguly jumps out of the crease, Murali bowls it flat, Ganguly checks his shot, gets a single. Lovely cat-and-mouse
full on the pads, worked away for a single
pitches leg and turns down the leg side
fails to connect on the sweep shot, but it is pitched outside leg
flighted on the pads, and worked away square this time
full on the pads, turned to short fine
length ball, into the pads, worked away for one
runs this one down to third man for one
comes down the track, clears the infield, only just, Ganguly turns down the second
pushed to pint where Badri makes a diving save
big big wicket! Shah was looking in prime touch. Superb ball, back of a length, lands on the seam, holds its line, and takes the hanging bat's edge, neatly taken by Dhoni too, to his right
short, on middle, gets a single to backward point, where Badri is fielding. He is out despite having run into a Dhoni running at full throttle
what a shot! dismissed! it's a swipe-pull, and has reached the cow corner boundary even before Gony can look up - 129kph, the speed off the bat
goes back to bowling short, but outside off, and is steered away for a single
Ganguly breaks free, goes straight this time, and lofts a length ball down the ground, Gony got the length wrong this time
mis-hit outside off, but they manage a single
nice crunchy punch shot outside off, one bounce to cover
into the hips again, works it away for a single
bye bye middle stump! Balaji finishes off what Gony started! Heaves at one again, and plays around a straight delivery
good shot, length ball wide outside off, and it goes crashing through the covers
gets inside the line this time, and works away to fine leg for a single
and again, makes much better contact this time, but still straight to the fielder
makes room to negate that rib attack, but can't pierce the off-side ring
tucks him up, short of a length, leg-stump line, Ganguly can't do much with that
Gony has been very unlucky this over, again troubles him with the inward movement, but the inside edge flies past the keeper
wafts outside off, beaten by the inward movement
length ball, on off stump, pushed to mid-on
slower ball, hit straight to mid-on
another bouncer, he was expecting this one, got on top of it, and murdered it in front of square
good good bouncer, on to him even before he can get into the pull shot, and aimed right at his head, gets a top edge strong enough to clear Dhoni
fuller on the middle stump, pushes it to the left of Morkel, who fields it
walks across for the big on-side shot, misses it, and Morkel shouts for lbw but it is not even close
nicely played, short and wide, and he throws his arms at it, deliberately going in the air, and up and over point
into the ribs again, pulled away this time, gets a single to fine leg
first run off Morkel, short down the leg side, surely he is aiming at the ribs
makes room and cuts, but straight to backward point
shortish delivery, hit straight to cover-point
Hayden drops a high catch at first slip! He used to take 95 out of 100 such, edged hard over first slip, jumps high, gets his hands to it but can't collect it
drives a full delivery square off third man, comes back for two
shortish delivery, hit straight to point
bowled him! Gony has come right back, with an in-coming delivery. Tiwary hits through its line, but the ball moves in and takes the inside edge onto the middle stump. Chennai right on top
that's more like an intended shot, pulled away past midwicket, welcome Gony!
regulation edge outside off, but there is just one slip in place and it beats him
length ball, hit back to Morkel, and Kolkata start another of their innings with a wicket-maiden
and he tucks him up again, into the ribs, defended again
on target again, tucking him up, played back to the bowler
quick delivery, 137ks, beats Ganguly for pace, the lbw shout is not good because it is pitched outside leg, Raina tries to pull a fast one by hitting the stumps direct but Ganguly is safe
the highest scorer in t20 is gone! short ball, pulled away in the air, and one of the tallest men of the field, R Ashwin, times him jump to a nicety and off goes Hodge
seems slightly surprised by the bounce, , defended back to the bowler
